content:
Clara (Finance): Heads-up — Partner payout for reseller 'BlueHarbor' is short $9,720 this month. Their partner statement shows a single refund line but AWS invoice has the refund applied to the customer invoice and also as a separate negative partner adjustment. Suspect double reflection during our refund sync.
Diego (Billing Ops): Can you paste the invoice snippet?
Clara (Finance): Snippet: 
```
invoice 2028-04-01 - customer CUST-992
line 21: usage RWINF-PREM 1,200.00
line 22: refund CREDIT-2028-03-RETRO -1,200.00
line 23: partner_adjustment -1,200.00
```
Zoe (Partner Success): BlueHarbor noticed the short payout and escalated. They received partner_adjustment on their statement but AWS charged the refund back to them via a negative payout line as well.
aws-marketplace-bot: AWS invoice INV-AWS-2028-04-01 posted 2028-04-02T09:14:03Z.
Diego (Billing Ops): Root cause likely in refund-processor: we emit a refund to AWS and also create a partner reversal when the refund is customer-facing. There's an edge-case where both actions run for subscription types with partner_share=true. I'll check the job logs.
Marta (Revenue Ops): Exposure amount? Need to know if we can auto-approve payout correction.
Clara (Finance): Quick query: `SELECT reseller_id, SUM(amount) FROM partner_statements WHERE line_type='partner_adjustment' AND period='2028-04' GROUP BY reseller_id;` shows BlueHarbor delta $9,720 and 3 other small partners totaling $2,120. Total exposure $11,840.
Diego (Billing Ops): Opening internal bug: RP-3145. I'll also open AWS support ticket to see if they can void the partner negative payout line or if we must issue a credit.
Zoe (Partner Success): BlueHarbor requests immediate provisional payout for the $9.7k; they provided signed acknowledgement to receive a provisional payment pending reconciliation.
Marta (Revenue Ops): Accounting: provisional payouts <= $10k can be processed as contra-revenue. This one is right at threshold. Approve once finance logs the payable and we flag contrarevenue.
Clara (Finance): I'll prepare the payable and credit memo template. Approve provisional payout for BlueHarbor. For the other partners, auto-approve since each < $5k.
aws-marketplace-bot: Support case opened with AWS: case 444777888.
Diego (Billing Ops): Action plan: 1) patch refund-processor to skip partner reversal when AWS refund already creates partner adjustment; 2) run ledger diff and generate CSV of impacted resellers; 3) issue provisional payouts and credit memos; 4) once AWS confirms, reconcile and reverse provisional payouts if needed.
Zoe (Partner Success): Uploaded CSV and ack: https://redwood.app/sheets/marketplace-refund-sync -> sheet "blueharbor-refunds-2028-04". Columns: reseller_id, invoice_id, customer_invoice, amount, action.
Marta (Revenue Ops): Please tag me when the payable is posted so I can check the contra-revenue entry.
Clara (Finance): Posted payable in AP with memo "provisional payout BlueHarbor - refund double apply". Linking doc: internal AP link.
Diego (Billing Ops): Patch in staging now; prod deploy ETA 3 hours after smoke test. Will post logs.
Zoe (Partner Success): BlueHarbor confirmed they want immediate payout; I've got the signed ack attached to the sheet.
Clara (Finance): Marking P1 until payouts complete. Keep updates short in-thread for audit trail. :heavy_check_mark:
